candidate_assessment.supported_candidate: The supplied context positively supports predictive-prophecy discovery for this statement.
candidate_assessment.possible_candidate: Some evidence supports that reading, while a competing reading remains.
candidate_assessment.no_support_in_supplied_context: The supplied context provides no positive support. This does not establish non-prophecy.
candidate_assessment.underdetermined: The supplied evidence does not distinguish the available outcomes.

statement_function.predictive_content: The named statement itself communicates predictive content.
statement_function.contributes_to_predictive_content: The named statement itself contributes content to a predictive announcement governed in this context.
statement_function.narration_introducing_or_reporting_predi: The named statement only introduces, reports, or frames nearby predictive content; it is not itself predictive content or a contribution to it.
statement_function.other_content: The named statement has another function in the supplied context.
statement_function.underdetermined: The supplied evidence does not distinguish these functions.

relationship.establishes_announcement_anchor: The statement establishes a predictive announcement anchor within this context.
relationship.contributes_to_announcement_anchor: The statement contributes to an announcement elsewhere in this context.
relationship.surrounding_or_other_content: The statement is surrounding material or has another discourse function.
relationship.relationship_underdetermined: The supplied context does not distinguish the statement's relationship.

v.source_text: וַ יִּֽקַּֽח ל֥ וֹ לֶ֖מֶךְ שְׁתֵּ֣י נָשִׁ֑ים שֵׁ֤ם הָֽ אַחַת֙ עָדָ֔ה וְ שֵׁ֥ם הַ שֵּׁנִ֖ית צִלָּֽה
וַ תֵּ֥לֶד עָדָ֖ה אֶת יָבָ֑ל ה֣וּא הָיָ֔ה אֲבִ֕י יֹשֵׁ֥ב אֹ֖הֶל וּ מִקְנֶֽה
וְ שֵׁ֥ם אָחִ֖י ו יוּבָ֑ל ה֣וּא הָיָ֔ה אֲבִ֕י כָּל תֹּפֵ֥שׂ כִּנּ֖וֹר וְ עוּגָֽב
וְ צִלָּ֣ה גַם הִ֗וא יָֽלְדָה֙ אֶת תּ֣וּבַל קַ֔יִן לֹטֵ֕שׁ כָּל חֹרֵ֥שׁ נְחֹ֖שֶׁת וּ בַרְזֶ֑ל וַֽ אֲח֥וֹת תּֽוּבַל קַ֖יִן נַֽעֲמָֽה
וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר לֶ֜מֶךְ לְ נָשָׁ֗י ו עָדָ֤ה וְ צִלָּה֙ שְׁמַ֣עַן קוֹלִ֔ י נְשֵׁ֣י לֶ֔מֶךְ הַאְזֵ֖נָּה אִמְרָתִ֑ י כִּ֣י אִ֤ישׁ הָרַ֨גְתִּי֙ לְ פִצְעִ֔ י וְ יֶ֖לֶד לְ חַבֻּרָתִֽ י
כִּ֥י שִׁבְעָתַ֖יִם יֻקַּם קָ֑יִן וְ לֶ֖מֶךְ שִׁבְעִ֥ים וְ שִׁבְעָֽה
